name: Automatic tempered glass frame installation machine
summary: Automatically installs tempered glass frames for educational monitors. Uses vision positioning with accuracy up to ±0.15mm.
contentHtml:
The automatic tempered glass frame installation machine is an automated assembly unit developed by TXAM for educational display products.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a CCD vision system to automatically identify product positions, guiding the robot to complete precise tempered glass frame installation. Positioning accuracy is up to ±0.15mm.

Technical Advantages

  • Positioning accuracy of ±0.15mm, industry-leading
  • Uses vision positioning, strong adaptability
  • TX-NS-ACTGR-02 model has faster cycle time
  • Specifically designed for educational display products
